title: 网络安全 · 安全治理、风险与合规 30 句
description: 覆盖安全战略、政策、风险偏好、第三方、审计、隐私、指标与董事会汇报的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 安全战略必须支持业务目标，否则控制投入很容易与实际风险脱节。
items.en: The security strategy must support business objectives; otherwise, investment in controls can easily become detached from actual risk.
answers: The security strategy must support business objectives; otherwise, investment in controls can easily become detached from actual risk.
items.notes: otherwise 引出战略脱节的后果；be detached from 表示与……脱离。

items.zh: 董事会批准的是风险偏好，而管理层负责把它转化为具体容忍限度。
items.en: The board approves the risk appetite, while management is responsible for translating it into specific tolerance thresholds.
answers: The board approves the risk appetite, while management is responsible for translating it into specific tolerance thresholds.
items.notes: while 划分治理职责；translate A into B 表示转化。

items.zh: 年度计划优先处理可能阻碍市场扩张的控制缺口，而不是平均分配预算。
items.en: The annual plan prioritises control gaps that could impede market expansion rather than distributing the budget evenly.
answers: The annual plan prioritises control gaps that could impede market expansion rather than distributing the budget evenly.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；rather than doing 对比资源配置方式。

items.zh: 安全委员会需要有权作出决定，不能只是接收各团队的状态更新。
items.en: The security committee needs authority to make decisions, not merely a mandate to receive status updates from each team.
answers: The security committee needs authority to make decisions, not merely a mandate to receive status updates from each team.
items.notes: authority to do 表示决策权；not merely 对比形式与实质职责。

items.zh: 只有明确谁对风险结果负责，职责矩阵才不只是项目文件。
items.en: A responsibility matrix has practical value only when it is clear who is accountable for the risk outcome.
answers: A responsibility matrix has practical value only when it is clear who is accountable for the risk outcome.
items.notes: only when 限定实用价值；who 引导责任主体从句。

items.zh: 政策说明组织必须实现什么，标准则规定达到要求所需的最低控制。
items.en: A policy states what the organisation must achieve, whereas a standard defines the minimum controls required to meet that expectation.
answers: A policy states what the organisation must achieve, whereas a standard defines the minimum controls required to meet that expectation.
items.notes: whereas 对比政策与标准；required 作后置定语。

items.zh: 如果一项规则无法执行，反复批准例外并不能使它成为有效政策。
items.en: If a rule cannot be enforced, repeatedly approving exceptions does not make it an effective policy.
answers: If a rule cannot be enforced, repeatedly approving exceptions does not make it an effective policy.
items.notes: if 引出可执行性问题；make A B 是宾补结构。

items.zh: 政策评审应考虑技术和业务变化，而不应仅更新文件日期。
items.en: A policy review should consider changes in technology and business practice rather than merely updating the document date.
answers: A policy review should consider changes in technology and business practice rather than merely updating the document date.
items.notes: rather than merely doing 批评形式化评审；consider 表示纳入考虑。

items.zh: 员工确认已阅读政策并不能证明他们理解如何在具体场景中应用它。
items.en: An employee's acknowledgement of a policy does not demonstrate that they understand how to apply it in a specific situation.
answers: An employee's acknowledgement of a policy does not demonstrate that they understand how to apply it in a specific situation.
items.notes: does not demonstrate that 限定确认记录的证明力；how to apply 表应用方式。

items.zh: 例外流程必须记录业务理由、补偿控制、风险接受人和失效日期。
items.en: The exception process must record the business justification, compensating controls, risk owner, and expiry date.
answers: The exception process must record the business justification, compensating controls, risk owner, and expiry date.
items.notes: 四个并列名词构成有效例外记录；expiry date 表示到期日。

items.zh: 固有风险反映没有特定控制时的暴露，剩余风险则考虑控制实际效果。
items.en: Inherent risk reflects exposure before specific controls are considered, whereas residual risk takes account of their actual effectiveness.
answers: Inherent risk reflects exposure before specific controls are considered, whereas residual risk takes account of their actual effectiveness.
items.notes: whereas 对比两类风险；take account of 是正式搭配。

items.zh: 把可能性评为低并不表示事件不可能发生，而是说明在既定时段内相对不常见。
items.en: Rating likelihood as low does not mean that an event is impossible; it indicates that the event is relatively uncommon within the defined period.
answers: Rating likelihood as low does not mean that an event is impossible; it indicates that the event is relatively uncommon within the defined period.
items.notes: does not mean 与 indicates that 精确定义低可能性。

items.zh: 风险登记册应展示控制失效会影响哪个业务目标，而不仅是技术资产名称。
items.en: The risk register should show which business objective would be affected by control failure, not just the name of the technical asset.
answers: The risk register should show which business objective would be affected by control failure, not just the name of the technical asset.
items.notes: which 引导宾语从句；not just 强调业务语境。

items.zh: 不同部门使用同一风险量表，才能让管理层比较资源需求。
items.en: A common risk scale across departments enables management to compare competing demands for resources.
answers: A common risk scale across departments enables management to compare competing demands for resources.
items.notes: enable someone to do 表示使比较成为可能；competing demands 指相互竞争的需求。

items.zh: 风险接受必须有明确期限，因为业务背景和威胁环境都可能改变。
items.en: Risk acceptance must be time-bound because both the business context and the threat landscape may change.
answers: Risk acceptance must be time-bound because both the business context and the threat landscape may change.
items.notes: time-bound 表示有期限；both ... and 并列变化因素。

items.zh: 供应商问卷提供初步信息，却不能替代与服务关键性相称的证据审查。
items.en: A supplier questionnaire provides initial information but does not replace an evidence review proportionate to the criticality of the service.
answers: A supplier questionnaire provides initial information but does not replace an evidence review proportionate to the criticality of the service.
items.notes: proportionate to 表示与……相称；but 限定问卷作用。

items.zh: 外包运营不会转移监管责任，因此合同需要支持客户的监督义务。
items.en: Outsourcing an operation does not transfer regulatory accountability, so the contract must support the client's oversight obligations.
answers: Outsourcing an operation does not transfer regulatory accountability, so the contract must support the client's oversight obligations.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；so 连接责任保留与合同要求。

items.zh: 若分包商可以访问敏感数据，主供应商应披露其位置和所实施的控制。
items.en: Where a subcontractor can access sensitive data, the primary supplier should disclose its location and the controls it applies.
answers: Where a subcontractor can access sensitive data, the primary supplier should disclose its location and the controls it applies.
items.notes: where 引出适用条件；并列 disclose 的两个宾语。

items.zh: 服务终止条款必须说明数据如何返还、删除如何证明以及访问何时撤销。
items.en: The termination clause must state how data will be returned, how deletion will be evidenced, and when access will be revoked.
answers: The termination clause must state how data will be returned, how deletion will be evidenced, and when access will be revoked.
items.notes: 三个疑问词从句并列，覆盖退出管理关键问题。

items.zh: 持续监控关注供应商风险是否变化，而不是每年重复收集同一份文件。
items.en: Continuous monitoring examines whether supplier risk has changed rather than collecting the same documents once a year.
answers: Continuous monitoring examines whether supplier risk has changed rather than collecting the same documents once a year.
items.notes: whether 引导监控内容；rather than doing 对比动态与形式化监督。

items.zh: 审计样本说明所选交易是否合规，但不能自动代表整个年度的控制表现。
items.en: An audit sample shows whether the selected transactions complied, but it cannot automatically represent control performance throughout the year.
answers: An audit sample shows whether the selected transactions complied, but it cannot automatically represent control performance throughout the year.
items.notes: whether 引导审计结论；throughout 表示整个期间。

items.zh: 管理层提供的解释只有得到独立证据支持，才能关闭审计发现。
items.en: A management explanation can close an audit finding only when it is supported by independent evidence.
answers: A management explanation can close an audit finding only when it is supported by independent evidence.
items.notes: only when 限定关闭条件；be supported by evidence 是审计搭配。

items.zh: 合规映射可以复用一项控制的证据，但各项法规的具体义务仍需分别确认。
items.en: Compliance mapping can reuse evidence for a common control, although the specific obligations of each regulation must still be confirmed separately.
answers: Compliance mapping can reuse evidence for a common control, although the specific obligations of each regulation must still be confirmed separately.
items.notes: although 引出证据复用的边界；separately 强调逐项确认。

items.zh: 在审计日期前临时执行控制，无法证明它在整个评估期内持续有效。
items.en: Operating a control temporarily before the audit date cannot demonstrate that it was effective throughout the assessment period.
answers: Operating a control temporarily before the audit date cannot demonstrate that it was effective throughout the assessment period.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；throughout 限定持续有效期间。

items.zh: 整改关闭不仅需要完成行动，还需要验证行动确实降低了相关风险。
items.en: Closing remediation requires not only completion of the action but also evidence that the action reduced the associated risk.
answers: Closing remediation requires not only completion of the action but also evidence that the action reduced the associated risk.
items.notes: not only ... but also 并列完成和效果证据。

items.zh: 收集个人数据之前，项目应明确处理目的以及实现目的所需的最少字段。
items.en: Before collecting personal data, the project should define the processing purpose and the minimum fields needed to achieve it.
answers: Before collecting personal data, the project should define the processing purpose and the minimum fields needed to achieve it.
items.notes: before doing 表示隐私前置；needed 作后置定语。

items.zh: 同意不是所有处理活动的唯一依据，尤其是在用户无法自由拒绝服务时。
items.en: Consent is not the only lawful basis for processing, particularly where a user cannot freely decline the service.
answers: Consent is not the only lawful basis for processing, particularly where a user cannot freely decline the service.
items.notes: particularly where 引出同意可能无效的场景；lawful basis 是隐私术语。

items.zh: 保留计划必须根据业务和法律需要设定期限，并在期限结束后真正执行删除。
items.en: A retention schedule must set periods according to business and legal needs and ensure that deletion actually occurs when those periods end.
answers: A retention schedule must set periods according to business and legal needs and ensure that deletion actually occurs when those periods end.
items.notes: according to 表示依据；ensure that 强调落地结果。

items.zh: 董事会指标应揭示风险趋势和决策需求，而不能只统计团队完成了多少活动。
items.en: Board metrics should reveal risk trends and decisions required, rather than merely counting how many activities the team completed.
answers: Board metrics should reveal risk trends and decisions required, rather than merely counting how many activities the team completed.
items.notes: rather than merely doing 对比结果指标与活动指标。

items.zh: 如果指标改善只是因为统计口径改变，报告就必须说明变化以免误导趋势判断。
items.en: If a metric improves only because its definition has changed, the report must disclose that change to avoid a misleading trend.
answers: If a metric improves only because its definition has changed, the report must disclose that change to avoid a misleading trend.
items.notes: if 引出指标可比性条件；to avoid 说明披露目的。
